title: The Necessary Mask

sourceEvidence.locator: nearly every serious moral life contains a gap
sourceEvidence.excerpt: nearly every serious moral life contains a gap between affirmed principles and achievable conduct. People praise equality while favoring their children, defend truth while using discretion, value freedom while constraining developing children, and celebrate objectivity inside institutions populated by status-sensitive, frightened, ambitious animals. Some gaps are frauds; others arise from incompatible obligations, limited capacity, social coordination, privacy, fear, or developmental transition.

hook: The Necessary Mask challenges the idea that hypocrisy is always worse than open cruelty.
readerPromise: Readers who distrust easy accusations will find harder distinctions to wrestle with. When does an imperfect ideal still give us something worth demanding from one another?
